; A version-unrestricted scene-graph cursor.
; The installer checks xochitl stability and rolls back on failure.
; The cursor itself uses no framebuffer pointer, private Qt call, or hot
; swapBuffers patch. The surrounding XOVI resource rebuilder remains tethered.
; Skin (cross | win95) is read from a one-line status file written by the daemon.
; Cursor FIFO stays in upright logical coordinates. UI rotation for touch is
; resolved by the daemon from xochitl logs — Qt Screen.orientation stays at
; portrait on Paper Pro and must not drive touch mapping.
AFFECT /qml/device/view/main/MainView.qml
    IMPORT net.asivery.XoviMessageBroker 2.0
    IMPORT net.asivery.CommandExecutor 1.0
    IMPORT xofm.libs.epaper 1.0 Epaper

    TRAVERSE Background
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            Item {
                id: paperPointerCursorLayer
                anchors.fill: parent
                clip: true
                z: 1000000
                visible: false

                property real normalizedX: 0.5
                property real normalizedY: 0.5
                property bool streamSeen: false
                // cross | win95 — win95 requires cursors/win95.png
                property string cursorStyle: "cross"
                property int spriteW: 33
                property int spriteH: 33
                property int hotspotX: 16
                property int hotspotY: 16

                function refreshSpriteMetrics() {
                    if (paperPointerCursorLayer.cursorStyle === "win95" &&
                        paperPointerWin95Image.status === Image.Ready) {
                        // 2x the source PNG (32→64) for readability on e-ink.
                        paperPointerCursorLayer.spriteW = 64;
                        paperPointerCursorLayer.spriteH = 64;
                        paperPointerCursorLayer.hotspotX = 0;
                        paperPointerCursorLayer.hotspotY = 0;
                    } else {
                        // Crosshair (default) or win95 fallback while PNG loads.
                        paperPointerCursorLayer.spriteW = 33;
                        paperPointerCursorLayer.spriteH = 33;
                        paperPointerCursorLayer.hotspotX = 16;
                        paperPointerCursorLayer.hotspotY = 16;
                    }
                }

                function applyCursorStyle(name) {
                    var style = (name || "").trim().toLowerCase();
                    if (style === "win95")
                        paperPointerCursorLayer.cursorStyle = "win95";
                    else
                        paperPointerCursorLayer.cursorStyle = "cross";
                    paperPointerCursorLayer.refreshSpriteMetrics();
                }

                function applyCursorMessage(message) {
                    var fields = message.trim().split(",");
                    if (fields.length !== 3)
                        return;
                    var nx = Number(fields[0]);
                    var ny = Number(fields[1]);
                    if (!isFinite(nx) || !isFinite(ny))
                        return;

                    paperPointerCursorLayer.streamSeen = true;
                    paperPointerCursorLayer.normalizedX = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, nx));
                    paperPointerCursorLayer.normalizedY = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, ny));
                    // Visibility is owned by the daemon: stay painted while a
                    // Bluetooth pointer is connected, even if it is idle.
                    paperPointerCursorLayer.visible = fields[2] === "1";
                }

                XoviMessageBroker {
                    listeningFor: ["paperpointer.ping"]

                    function onSignalReceived(signal, message) {
                        if (signal === "paperpointer.ping") {
                            if (paperPointerCursorLayer.streamSeen &&
                                paperPointerReader.running)
                                return "paperpointer-cursor-ready-v1";
                            return "paperpointer-not-ready";
                        }
                        return "";
                    }
                }

                Timer {
                    id: paperPointerReaderRestartTimer
                    interval: 250
                    repeat: false
                    onTriggered: {
                        if (!paperPointerReader.running &&
                            !paperPointerReader.startCommand(100))
                            paperPointerReaderRestartTimer.restart();
                    }
                }

                AsyncCommandExecutor {
                    id: paperPointerReader
                    // Keep one read/write descriptor inherited by cat. Without
                    // it, a daemon restart closes the FIFO's last writer, cat
                    // exits on EOF, and some CommandExecutor builds do not
                    // reliably relaunch it from onRunningChanged.
                    command: "/bin/sh"
                    arguments: ["-c", "[ -p /home/root/.paperpointer/cursor.fifo ] || exit 70; exec 3<>/home/root/.paperpointer/cursor.fifo; exec /bin/cat /home/root/.paperpointer/cursor.fifo"]

                    onStdOutAvailable: function(output) {
                        paperPointerCursorLayer.applyCursorMessage(output);
                    }
                    onRunningChanged: {
                        if (!running)
                            paperPointerReaderRestartTimer.restart();
                    }
                    Component.onCompleted: {
                        if (!startCommand(100))
                            paperPointerReaderRestartTimer.restart();
                    }
                    Component.onDestruction: terminateCommand(100)
                }

                // Fixed path only: never accept free-form style text as a command.
                AsyncCommandExecutor {
                    id: paperPointerStyleReader
                    command: "/bin/cat"
                    arguments: ["/home/root/.paperpointer/cursor_style"]

                    onStdOutAvailable: function(output) {
                        paperPointerCursorLayer.applyCursorStyle(output);
                    }
                }

                Timer {
                    id: paperPointerStylePollTimer
                    interval: 2000
                    repeat: true
                    running: true
                    onTriggered: {
                        if (!paperPointerStyleReader.running)
                            paperPointerStyleReader.startCommand(100);
                    }
                }

                Component.onCompleted: {
                    if (!paperPointerStyleReader.startCommand(100))
                        paperPointerStylePollTimer.restart();
                }

                // The mode item must cover both the old and new cursor damage.
                // A moving 33x33 mode item only tags the new rectangle, so its
                // erase can fall back to the slower UI waveform and leave the
                // visible cursor behind the actual click target.
                Epaper.ScreenModeItem {
                    anchors.fill: parent
                    objectName: "paperpointer-fast-region"
                    mode: Epaper.ScreenModeItem.Pen

                    Item {
                        id: paperPointerSprite
                        width: paperPointerCursorLayer.spriteW
                        height: paperPointerCursorLayer.spriteH
                        x: Math.round(paperPointerCursorLayer.normalizedX *
                                      (paperPointerCursorLayer.width - 1)) -
                           paperPointerCursorLayer.hotspotX
                        y: Math.round(paperPointerCursorLayer.normalizedY *
                                      (paperPointerCursorLayer.height - 1)) -
                           paperPointerCursorLayer.hotspotY
                        objectName: "paperpointer-cursor"

                        // Optional PNG skin. If the file is missing or fails to
                        // load, keep the geometry crosshair visible underneath.
                        Image {
                            id: paperPointerWin95Image
                            anchors.fill: parent
                            visible: paperPointerCursorLayer.cursorStyle === "win95" &&
                                     status === Image.Ready
                            source: "file:///home/root/.paperpointer/cursors/win95.png"
                            fillMode: Image.PreserveAspectFit
                            // Nearest-neighbor style scale: sharper 2x pixel arrow.
                            smooth: false
                            mipmap: false
                            asynchronous: true
                            cache: true
                            onStatusChanged: paperPointerCursorLayer.refreshSpriteMetrics()
                        }

                        // Default geometry crosshair (centered hotspot).
                        Item {
                            anchors.fill: parent
                            visible: paperPointerCursorLayer.cursorStyle !== "win95" ||
                                     paperPointerWin95Image.status !== Image.Ready
                            Rectangle { width: 33; height: 5; y: 14; color: "white" }
                            Rectangle { width: 31; height: 3; x: 1; y: 15; color: "black" }
                            Rectangle { width: 5; height: 33; x: 14; color: "white" }
                            Rectangle { width: 3; height: 31; x: 15; y: 1; color: "black" }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
